references.text: The Year of Jubilee is the basis for calculating the value of a consecrated field. In the Year of Jubilee, all property was to return to its original owner, which affects the valuation of consecrated land.
The following verses explain what happens if a field is consecrated after the Year of Jubilee and how its value should then be calculated and redeemed.
The principle that value is calculated based on the number of years remaining until the Year of Jubilee parallels the calculation of the value of a consecrated field.
This section deals with the valuation of persons who are consecrated to the Lord and provides background on how valuation works in consecration generally.
